Container.Name: ez1-monitor
Container.Overview: Lean, self-hosted dashboard for the APsystems EZ1 microinverter family, straight from the inverter's local API: live power, every day's curve, fair comparisons, records, savings and payback, and a sun path with an optional weather forecast. No cloud, no account, no telemetry. [br][br] [b]Before you start:[/b][br] 1. Give the inverter a fixed IP (DHCP reservation).[br] 2. In the AP EasyPower app, set its Local Mode to Continuous.[br] 3. Check that it answers: [i]curl http://<ez1-ip>:8050/getDeviceInfo[/i] [br][br] Only the inverter IP is required. Everything else, including price, payback, sun path, weather and CO2, is under Advanced View.

Config.Name: Inverter IP
Config.Description: IP address or hostname of the inverter.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port of the dashboard.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database and caches.

Config.Name: UI language
Config.Description: de or en. Empty = browser language.

Config.Name: Inverter port
Config.Description: Port of the inverter's local API.

Config.Name: Poll interval (s)
Config.Description: 10x slower, at most 5 min, while the inverter sleeps.

Config.Name: Data retention (days)
Config.Description: Raw readings to keep, 0 = forever. Aggregates are always kept.

Config.Name: Lifetime offset (kWh)
Config.Description: Correction of the lifetime total, e.g. a counter wrap from before the monitor ran. See README.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR.

Config.Name: Electricity price per kWh
Config.Description: Stamped on every reading, so a new tariff only affects new production.

Config.Name: Currency
Config.Description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. EUR, USD, CHF.

Config.Name: Self-consumption (%)
Config.Description: Share of production you use yourself.

Config.Name: Feed-in tariff per kWh
Config.Description: Paid for the share you feed in. Often 0 for a balcony plant.

Config.Name: Installation cost
Config.Description: Above 0 shows the payback card.

Config.Name: Site address
Config.Description: Address or lat,lon. Adds the sun's path and a map, looked up once at OpenStreetMap.

Config.Name: Building storeys
Config.Description: Sets your building's height where OpenStreetMap has none.

Config.Name: Weather forecast
Config.Description: true adds an hourly forecast from Open-Meteo. Needs the site address.

Config.Name: CO2 factor (kg/kWh)
Config.Description: Static grid factor, used without Electricity Maps.

Config.Name: Electricity Maps token
Config.Description: Live grid CO2 intensity, fetched hourly. Free token at electricitymaps.com/free-tier-api (Home Assistant path).

Config.Name: Electricity Maps zone
Config.Description: Label in the UI. The real zone is bound to the token.
